issues.location: least strict upper-bound proof, source lines 95–98
issues.finding: The last paragraph obtains that each member of supstrict(X) is at most some member of X, then immediately concludes minimality. It leaves unstated the comparison with an arbitrary strict upper-bound ordinal of X: that bound contains each such member, hence contains supstrict(X).
issues.proposed_resolution: State the comparison with any strict upper-bound ordinal in prose before concluding supstrict(X) is least. Preserve the displayed definition and all ordinal formulas.

translation_treatment: Translated successor/limit ordinals, three-way transfinite induction, and strict supremum. The final proof explicitly compares with every strict upper bound without adding formulas; frozen source bytes are unchanged.
